claims.claim_text: QuePaxa 讓任何 replica 都能推進共識，在遭受針對性連線攻擊的惡劣網路下，吞吐量比 Raft 與 Multi-Paxos 高約 10 倍。
claims.evidence: A client can contact any replica, and that replica can drive consensus for the latest slot. ... The authors found that it maintains much higher (~10x) throughput than Raft and Multi-Paxos during such conditions.

claims.claim_text: 一個管理跨 330 個資料中心控制平面狀態的全球共識服務……目前仍是實驗性、僅供內部使用。
claims.evidence: Many internal services at Cloudflare need to read and modify the same control-plane state from across our 330+ global data centers. ... Meerkat is an experimental consensus service that is still in development...this will be kept internal-only for the immediate future.

claims.claim_text: Chrome 148 把 V8 的 Math.tanh 從內建 fdlibm 換成呼叫平台 libm 的 std::tanh，結果同一句 Math.tanh(0.8) 在 Linux、macOS、Windows 上回傳的最後幾個 bit 各不相同，一次呼叫就能分辨底層作業系統。
claims.evidence: V8 commit c1486295ae5 replaced it with std::tanh, which reads the host libm. It first shipped in V8 14.8.57, which is Chrome 148. ... Until Chrome 148, V8 computed tanh itself with a bundled fdlibm port... Math.tanh(0.8): 0.6640367702678491 genuine Linux Chrome (glibc); 0.664036770267849 genuine macOS Chrome; 0.6640367702678489 genuine Windows Chrome (UCRT). One tanh call on the right input is a per-OS signature.

claims.claim_text: IEEE 754 規範怎麼存浮點數，卻沒規定 tanh 這類函式要正確捨入，於是各家 libm 的多項式係數差異就洩漏了出來。
claims.evidence: IEEE 754 defines how a double is stored. It does not require sin, cos, tanh, or exp to be correctly rounded. ... every vendor ships a libm that trades a fraction of a ULP for speed, with its own minimax coefficients, exponent tables, and reduction constants.

claims.claim_text: 公鑰 1,312 bytes、簽章 2,420 bytes，是 Ed25519 的幾十倍。
claims.evidence: ML-DSA-44: 1,312 byte public key and 2,420 byte signature; by comparison Ed25519 is 32 bytes public key / 64 bytes signature — roughly 40x larger public key and ~38x larger signature.

claims.claim_text: 更好的候選像 FN-DSA 要到 2033、MAYO/SNOVA 要到 2034 才可能上線，而法規要求的遷移期是 2030 到 2035。
claims.evidence: we wouldn't expect FN-DSA to be widely available before 2033 ... we might see a multivariate NIST standard in 2031, and wider product availability not earlier than 2034 ... [regulatory deadlines spanning] between 2030 and 2035.

claims.claim_text: 作者報告延遲快了 2.2 倍、成本降了 27%。
claims.evidence: 2.2× faster to a finished page ... 27% lower cost overall, with per-build expenses declining from $3.06 to $2.22.

claims.claim_text: Claude Code 在真正讀你的 prompt 之前，會先送出約 33k token 的固定開銷，而 OpenCode 只送約 7k。
claims.evidence: Claude Code used roughly 33,000 tokens of system prompt, tool schemas, and injected scaffolding before the prompt even arrived. OpenCode used about 7,000.

claims.claim_text: TypeScript 7 正式發布，編譯器改用 Go 重寫，編譯速度……比 6.x 大幅改善。
claims.evidence: TypeScript 7 出來的消息了 ... 去年就有提到用 Go 改寫的事情 ... 有些更快，但也有稍微慢一點的... 但與 TypeScript 6 比起來都是變快很多.

claims.claim_text: ……記憶體用量整體也略有下降。
claims.evidence: 記憶體的用量看起來沒有少非常多，不過整體看起來是有下降 (memory usage did not decrease very much, though overall there is some reduction). [FIX: lede changed from 記憶體用量大幅改善 to 略有下降, matching source]

claims.claim_text: 追下去發現是 bash 的 exec 優化：當某個指令是最後一步時，bash 會用 execve 直接取代自己而不 fork，於是少了那個負責回報子行程致命訊號的父行程。用 (./hello) 或補一個 true 逼 bash 保留父行程，訊息就回來了。
claims.evidence: When you run bash -c "some_command" and some_command is effectively the only thing to do, bash doesn't bother forking a new process for it. It just execve's into it, replacing itself. ... The message is printed by the shell when it reaps a child that died from SIGSEGV. No parent shell, no message. ... the parens force ./hello into a forked subshell, so bash can't exec its way out of being the parent. ... [adding `; true`] the shell has something to do after the crashing command.

claims.claim_text: 數學家 Terry Tao 記錄了他用現代 coding agent 重寫幾個新舊小工具的經驗……談 agent 在實際開發流程裡幫得上與幫不上的地方。
claims.evidence: I asked the agent to port my old applets to a modern supported language (we landed on Javascript), and it managed to do so in a matter of hours ... after a couple hours of 'vibe coding' with an AI agent, I was finally able to generate an applet that matched the vision I had back in 1999 ... LLM-based coding agents can create various blatant or subtle bugs in their code ... the agent identified two bugs in the original code that I was not aware of.

claims.claim_text: Dropbox 分享他們怎麼用 DSPy，把 AI 評測的結果回饋進 Dash chat，讓回覆品質變好。
claims.evidence: We used DSPy to turn evaluation into improvement. DSPy is an open-source framework for optimizing AI systems using evaluation feedback. ... This created a feedback loop: human labels improved the judges, the judges produced scalable evaluation signals, and those signals improved the agent.

claims.claim_text: AWS 開源了 ExtendDB，一個與 DynamoDB 相容的適配器，定位在開發與測試而非上線環境。
claims.evidence: Today, we are announcing ExtendDB, an open source Amazon DynamoDB-compatible adapter with pluggable storage backends, released under the Apache 2.0 License. ... any AWS SDK, CLI, or tool that works with DynamoDB works with ExtendDB, unchanged. ... [positioned] mainly to supplement development and testing interfaces rather than serve as a production-ready alternative.
